title: UrbanFlow Kafka Trip Event
description: Authoritative JSON Schema for Kafka trip events produced by urbanflow-replay and consumed by urbanflow-streaming. Foundation version 1.0.0. All seven fields are required.

event_time.description: Pickup time as RFC 3339 with explicit UTC offset. Producers and consumers must not infer its meaning from host time zone.

pickup_zone_id.description: Pickup taxi zone ID. Semantic validity uses the zone lookup.

dropoff_zone_id.description: Dropoff taxi zone ID. Semantic validity uses the zone lookup.

trip_duration_minutes.description: Trip duration in minutes. Must be >= 0.
